message.content: This is an OpenSSL vulnerability. The crash is `Heap-use-after-free WRITE 4` in `CRYPTO_DOWN_REF`, `DH_free`, `evp_pkey_free_legacy`. This is a known OpenSSL bug (CVE-2020-1967 / oss-fuzz issue 6296602006519808) related to DH parameter handling in the client fuzz target. Let me explore the fuzz target and relevant source.
